resources.string: Keeps the V Client HUD alive while Minecraft runs.
HUD overlay active. Tap V Menu to configure modules.

Optional V Client service. It enables: (1) detecting when Minecraft is focused so the HUD can hide elsewhere, (2) camera-magnification Zoom, (3) on Android 14+, reading raw touch motion so Keystrokes and the CPS counter reflect your real taps. V Client never reads screen content or text.
